value.finding: The L2b family is tokenized tumor_presence_discordant (symmetric, no attribution), but BOTH independent views attribute the split directionally: sc malignant non-detection + IHC-mostly-negative read as malignant-intrinsic-low while bulk-present is immune/stromal-weighted. Propose a human consider a directional disposition (bulk-present-is-microenvironment-weighted) rather than a symmetric discordance.
value.why: sc malignant_detection_fraction 0.02439 + IHC n_not_detected=10/12 + purity r=-0.39 all point the same way; the coverage family already names bulk_masks_low_coverage.

value.target: L2b (new island linking bulk presence to purity confound)
value.finding: The expression-purity correlation (r=-0.39) is cited by BOTH narrative and literature as the mechanistic reason bulk reads present while malignant-cell coverage is low, yet it appears in NO L2b family and NO L3 chapter. Propose surfacing a microenvironment-confound relationship tying bulk_presence + purity + malignant_low into one explanatory island.
value.why: The confound explains the tumor_presence discordance but is structurally unrepresented.

value.finding: The IHC arm's raw tier breakdown (n_high=1, n_medium=1, n_not_detected=10 of 12) is computed in the protein_presence datum but the L3 headline only says IHC detects the antigen. Propose the L3 headline/caveat surface the tier distribution so the IHC signal is not read as stronger than 10/12 not-detected warrants. NOTE: ihc_detected_low and corroboration:high are CORRECT BY CONTRACT (>=2 patients detected; independence-agreement not strength) — the gap is narrative surfacing, not a mislabelled class.
value.why: The datum exists but is not surfaced; the class label itself is contract-correct.

value.finding: The bulk_rna arm is class broadly_moderate with datum high_fraction=0.0222 and median_tpm=null. A high_fraction of 2.2% is a thin basis for present-by-breadth; it is present-by-distribution-percentile, not present-by-broad-detection. Propose a human check whether present on the bulk arm should be qualified as distribution-level rather than detection-level.
value.why: high_fraction 0.0222 contradicts a broad-detection reading on the label's own terms.

value.finding: The resolver's single_tumor_elevated (1/7 cohorts) captures bulk tumor-vs-normal contrast only, while the literature-documented driver (inducible, immune-context PD-L1) is orthogonal and unmeasured by any arm. value.why: Literature axis D explicitly extends the omics; the blind spot is structural.
